Subject: Re: Pen test report + vuln management process

Hi Liam / Priya — thanks for the clear asks. Quick details from our security/ops side: 

- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending Sep 2025. We can share the report under a standard NDA — will coordinate delivery once you confirm preferred transfer method.

- PHI/HIPAA: Redwood supports private deployments where customers can keep PHI isolated. For Redwood-hosted deployments, we can sign a BAA for customers with HIPAA needs; please let us know whether you expect Redwood-hosted or private.

- Pen testing: Our last third-party penetration test was performed Q4 2025. We do not publish the full report publicly but will provide the complete report to named FinHealth reviewers after an NDA and secure transfer.

- Vulnerability management & SLAs (high level):
  * Scanning cadence: weekly internal automated scans (SAST/DAST where applicable), monthly authenticated scans for critical surfaces, and quarterly third-party assessments plus ad-hoc pen tests before major releases.
  * Triage & remediation SLA: Critical (CVSS >=9) — mitigation or workaround within 7 days and remediation plan within 30 days; High (CVSS 7-8.9) — remediation plan within 30 days; Medium/Low — tracked and remediated per quarterly cycle. We can discuss exceptions for shared-responsibility items.
  * Disclosure policy: coordinated disclosure; 30-day window for critical vulnerabilities before public disclosure unless extended by mutual agreement.

- Evidence & artifacts we can provide: SOC 2 Type II report (NDA), pen test PDF (NDA + secure link), weekly/monthly scan summaries (redacted as needed), and our vulnerability tracking playbook.

If you prefer, we can push the full report to an SFTP you control or create a time-limited Drive link. Confirm the reviewers' emails and we'll start the NDA process.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Appreciate the quick turnaround on the questionnaire draft — we'll review your answers and revert with any gaps.
